name: F4F-4 Wildcat (our own model)
about: Made by tools/battle-models (aircraft). Metres; x forward, y right, z up. A battle model: `part` says which part each point belongs to; `parts` are the parts (parent, pivot, axis of turning, way of sliding); `sockets` are named places for flash, smoke, fire and wake; `clips` move the parts. Turns: +t degrees about an axis carries p to p cos t + (axis x p) sin t + axis (axis . p)(1 - cos t), about the part's pivot. Paints: 0 upper, 1 upper2, 2 under, 3 nose, 4 boss, 5 glass, 6 frame, 7 steel, 8 tyre, 9 blade, 10 line, 11 soot, 12 engine, 13 leg, 14 bomb, 15 stain, 16 glare, 17 glint, 18 torpedo, 19 torn, 20 blur, 21 blur_tip, 22 inside, 23 leather, 24 skin, 25 suit, 26 vest, 27 goggles, 28 exhaust, 29 boot, 30 lamp_red, 31 lamp_green, 32 lamp_white, 33 gunmetal, 34 patch, 35 lens, 36 rivet, 37 rivet_under, 38 seam, 39 seam_under

fly.about: Under way: every airscrew a turning disc, and she rides the air a little. The game flies her; this only lives on top.

idle.about: Engines ticking over on the ground or the deck: the blades are seen going round.

stopped.about: Engines stopped: blades still, no disc. For a parked machine.

bank.port.about: Rolls into a turn and holds it, her ailerons over as she rolls and her elevators up as she pulls round (lay it over `fly`; play it backwards to roll out).

bank.starboard.about: Rolls into a turn and holds it, her ailerons over as she rolls and her elevators up as she pulls round (lay it over `fly`; play it backwards to roll out).

peel_off.about: Half-rolls and pulls down into a dive (the game then flies her down).

flaps.down.about: Her flaps come down, for a landing or a take-off from a deck (play it backwards to raise them).

fire.about: Her fixed guns firing: a flicker at each muzzle, and she shakes with it.

hit.about: Struck: she staggers and a puff of smoke and scraps flies from her.

smoking.about: Damaged but flying: a thin grey stream from an engine.

fall_burn.about: Shot down burning: an engine alight, she drops a wing and goes down in a steepening dive, trailing fire and black smoke. The game carries her down; this is her attitude, her fire and her smoke. Play `bail_out` over it if her crew get out.

fall_spin.about: A wing shot off: the port wing breaks away at the root, she whirls down out of control, the wing fluttering down behind her. The game carries her down.

fall_explode.about: Blown up: a burst of fire amidships, both wings and the tail fly off and the pieces tumble away, burning. The game carries the wreck down and takes it away at the end.

bail_out.about: Her crew take to their parachutes: 1 leave one after another (the game spawns the Parachute model at each `chute` event).

tally.note: a slot is a place in the game's axes and the way the skin faces there (x, y, z, nx, ny, nz); fill each list in order

name.ink: one colour. Read the paint under the middle of the line as she flies (her scheme, her owner's colours, a mottle). On an American machine (her owner the USA) where that paint is olive drab (a dark brownish green: L* under 45, its red and green within a tenth of each other and both 15 or more above its blue): yellow D9B43A (the art director, 2026-11-22). Otherwise the bombers' record rule (tallies.py): black 1A1A1A where its lightness L* is 50 or more (bare metal, light grey, a pale mottle), else off-white F2F0E8
name.letters: plain block capitals, even stroke, about 0.7 as wide as high, no outline, shadow or script, upright on her side; the rank short as his nation wrote it, then his name (ACES.md): F/LT T. HARLAND. Fit it to `long` at `cap`, smaller down to `cap_min`; longer still, his first names to initials, then rank and surname, then the surname alone
name.note: his name, read from the front: line[k] is a point on the middle of the capitals' height and the way her skin faces there, from the front of the line (at) to its back, every 0.1 m (the last at its back); the first row of kills hangs below it
